source_authority.document: Ten Advances in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
loci: Theorem 1.2: for every fixed hierarchy level r>=0 and 0<s<1, interlacing parameters with 2*Gamma_r>s give A(n,s)<=2^((Phi_r+o(1))*n), and consequently R_sph(s) is bounded by the closed hierarchy infimum.
Corollary 1.3: for every 0<s<1 and every r>=0 the hierarchy improves strictly level by level, with the localized strict chain ending at the classical Kabatiansky-Levenshtein row.
Numerical level-2 consequence: the kissing number satisfies tau_n <= 2^((0.39661+o(1))*n); the source does not print an eventual exact exponent 0.39661 bound.

definition_concordance.binary_surface: main_binary_theorem uses the same fixed domain 0<delta<1/2 and states binaryRate(delta)<=combinedVariationalRate(delta)<mrrwRate(delta), corresponding to source R2<=kappa_bin<M2 under the already-audited B1 rate/log/variational conventions.
definition_concordance.spherical_code: SpherePacking.SphericalCode uses unit vectors with pairwise real inner product <=s; for 0<s<1 this is the source spherical-code convention after s=cos(theta), theta in (0,pi/2).
definition_concordance.rate: sphericalCodeRate is limsup_n log_2(A(n,s))/n, matching source R_sph(s); kissingNumber is sphericalCodeNumber at s=1/2.
definition_concordance.hierarchy: HigherHierarchy encodes r in Nat including r=0, interlacing a_0>b_0>a_1>... with final a_r>=0, the quadratic coordinate u(1+u), Lagrange weights, Gamma, Phi, levelRate, and the closed 2*Gamma>=s consequence.
definition_concordance.localization: localizedLevelRate and localizedHierarchyRate use the Sidelnikov envelope over Icc 0 s; the strict_hierarchy target records the source level-by-level and localized strict chain.
definition_concordance.numerical: the configured exact eventual 0.39661 exponent is stronger than the source-printed 0.39661+o(1) statement and is classified only as a formal strengthening entailing that asymptotic consequence.
